method.action: Read-only SHA-256 comparison of explicit frozen lists against current filesystem bytes.

membership_and_omissions.interpretation: Files outside the 279-file candidate are independently verified only within the explicitly requested legacy/package baselines. Their absence is a scope difference, not evidence of changed source or an assertion that the whole repository is frozen.

verification_package_identity.claim_limit: Hash equality preserves the 25-file isolated package assets; it does not grant professional quality authority, true sample availability/consumption, production readiness or formal acceptance.

limitations: No tests, database operations or .local/runtime.json reads were performed.
The 57-file legacy boundary does not cover the entire old dirty working tree; prior recovery limitations and formal human exits remain unchanged.
The 279-file comparison is a point-in-time source freeze check; reports, runtime state and omitted files are not certified by it.
Physical object deletion, actual scanner qualification, production enablement and formal Exit are not established by matching hashes.
